mapper.select:
SELECT base.task_id, base.title, base.duedate, base.task_status, u1.user_name as creator, u2.user_name as modifier FROM ( SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.duedate, t.created_by, t.modified_by, t.group_seq, tl.task_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.task_id ORDER BY tl.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM task t LEFT OUTER JOIN task_log tl on t.task_id = tl.task_id WHERE t.deleted_yn = 'N'
AND DATE(t.duedate) = CURDATE()
AND t.duedate BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND MONTH(t.duedate) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(t.duedate) = YEAR(CURDATE())
) base LEFT OUTER JOIN users u1 on base.created_by = u1.user_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u2 on base.modified_by = u2.user_seq WHERE base.group_seq in
#{seq}
AND base.rn = 1 ORDER BY base.duedate
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( title, duedate, deleted_yn, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, group_seq ) VALUE ( #{title}, #{duedate}, 'N', NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{modifiedBy}, #{groupSeq} )
